scope_statement: Africa is the intended MVP region, not a supported-country allowlist. HarvestStat Africa v1.2 supplies pinned subnational crop-history and boundary artifacts; coordinate matching is limited to exact FNIDs with historical crop records. Crop suitability, agronomic profile values, and recommendation support remain unverified unless separately sourced.

sources.name: HarvestStat Africa – Harmonized Subnational Crop Statistics

license.name: MIT License
license.notes: The upstream v1.2 repository README states the data in the repository is licensed under MIT. This entry refers to that release only; re-check the terms and upstream source-material notices for later releases or any other files.

spatial_coverage.description: Subnational crop statistics in 33 Sub-Saharan African countries; the coverage index records each source FNID and its reported admin level.
spatial_coverage.resolution: FEWS NET-aligned administrative units, admin level 1 or 2 as recorded per unit.
countries: Congo, The Democratic Republic of the

temporal_coverage.description: Year ranges are computed from the pinned v1.2 records' planting_year and harvest_year fields; coverage varies by country, crop, and season. These calendar fields identify reported seasons and are not actual phenological timing.

freshness.update_cycle: Dataset v1.2 changelog date; no automatic update is configured. The GitHub v1.2 release is pinned.

limitations: Historical crop production, harvested area, yield, and season labels indicate reported activity, not biological suitability, yield potential, or a recommendation.

The upstream README explicitly says planting_year, planting_month, harvest_year, and harvest_month distinguish multi-season systems and cross-calendar-year seasons; they do not represent actual phenological timing.
Country, crop, season, and administrative-unit coverage is uneven. Use the generated coverage index for the pinned release rather than assuming coverage from a country list.
The coverage index contains counts and date/month ranges, not the underlying production values or source rows.
The dataset is derived from multiple source documents and products; consult the upstream paper and source-material notes before interpreting or redistributing derived values.

sources.name: SoilGrids 2.0

license.name: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International
license.notes: The ISRIC documentation states that SoilGrids maps are available under CC BY 4.0; attribution is required.

spatial_coverage.resolution: 250 m; six standard depth intervals. Soil-property maps include pH, organic carbon, bulk density, coarse fragments, texture fractions, cation exchange capacity, and total nitrogen.

temporal_coverage.description: Modelled global soil-property surfaces; the cited documentation does not identify a single observation year or per-pixel observation date.

freshness.update_cycle: The cited documentation describes a regularly updateable product but does not state a fixed update schedule.

limitations: Predictions include uncertainty; use the documented prediction intervals and do not treat a 250 m cell as a field survey.
ISRIC reports that the SoilGrids REST API is temporarily paused. Prefer its documented WCS/WebDAV alternatives and verify service availability before integration.
Global availability does not establish local suitability or guarantee complete quality at every location.

sources.name: Climate Hazards Center Infrared Precipitation with Stations version 3

license.name: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International; public domain dedication to the extent possible under law
license.notes: The CHC v3 page states both the public-domain dedication and CC BY 4.0 licensing; retain attribution and the data citation.

spatial_coverage.description: Quasi-global land precipitation from 60°N to 60°S, all longitudes; includes Africa.

temporal_coverage.description: 1981 to near-present. Pentad and monthly are fundamental products; daily products are derived by disaggregating pentad totals.

freshness.update_cycle: Preliminary products are released 2 days after each pentad; final products are produced monthly, typically in the third week of the following month.

limitations: Daily values are downscaled from pentad totals; dates are consistent labels, not uniform local observation windows across station sources.
Satellite and station estimates can have biases, including underestimation of extreme precipitation in complex terrain.
This catalog identifies the source but contains no CHIRPS raster values or computed climate summaries.

sources.name: FAO ECOCROP

license.name: Not confirmed
license.notes: The FAO portal describes ECOCROP but the retrieved page did not state a data license. Verify terms for the selected database content before reuse or redistribution.

spatial_coverage.description: Species-level plant and environmental descriptors; not a georeferenced suitability layer.
spatial_coverage.resolution: Not spatially gridded; the FAO portal describes a database for more than 2,000 plant species.

temporal_coverage.description: The FAO page says ECOCROP was developed in the 1990s and is gradually integrated into GAEZ; no data vintage or temporal coverage is stated.

freshness.update_cycle: The FAO page says the application is updated and gradually integrated into GAEZ but gives no release date or schedule.

limitations: The portal describes environmental descriptors such as minimum/maximum temperature, annual precipitation, soil pH, light, climate zone, photoperiod sensitivity, latitude, and altitude; values for individual crops have not been independently reviewed or copied into this catalog.
No cultivar-specific, local planting-window, or regional suitability values are included.
The database page does not provide a verified license or a dated data release.

sources.name: HarvestStat Africa v1.2 administrative boundaries

license.name: MIT License
license.notes: The upstream v1.2 repository README states repository data is licensed under MIT. This entry refers to the pinned v1.2 boundary file only; inspect upstream source-material notices before using other versions or assets.

spatial_coverage.description: Subnational administrative polygons across 33 Sub-Saharan African countries. The boundary file contains 1,128 features; 1,041 FNIDs intersect the pinned historical crop coverage index.
spatial_coverage.resolution: Administrative-area polygons at admin level 1 or 2 as named by the source, not a uniform ground-distance grid. GeoPackage geometry CRS is EPSG:4326 (WGS 84).
countries: Congo, The Democratic Republic of the

temporal_coverage.description: Versioned administrative boundary snapshot; not a boundary time series. The GeoPackage metadata records last_change 2026-05-18T13:59:31.163Z.

freshness.update_cycle: Pinned to the v1.2 GeoPackage. Boundary changes require an explicit source/version review and a rebuilt coverage join.

limitations: Only an exact unique interior polygon match is returned. Points on boundaries, overlapping polygons, points outside polygons, and areas without a matching historical crop index record are not assigned to a nearby or parent area.
A spatial intersection identifies an administrative area with historical reported crops; it does not establish suitability, current support, or agronomic evidence.
Boundary polygons represent the source's administrative delineation and may not reflect current or field-level boundaries.
The original source dataset documentation does not state a uniform map scale or ground-distance resolution.

regional_coverage.absence_semantics: No matching index row means no historical record for this exact crop/FNID/season in the pinned source release; it does not mean the crop is absent or unsuitable.
